items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: I did my last recording which will come out as my record under Concord Jazz label from the -- Carl Jefferson... It's a pleasure to work for Carl

ctx.x: I don't know the guy. He was one of the guys that invented the Norton Bomb Site. He was a technician. He didn't know anything about music. He didn't know anything about records, nothing. All he was was a technician and he built one of the finest boards for recording for a technician to work with while recording. He was one of the innovators of the building of the boards with the eight, nine, ten, 12, 14, 16 tracks and he had this out on the edge of Long Island, one of those places out there. So, that was my first…

Just recently, a month ago, I did my last recording which will come out as my record under Concord Jazz label from the -- Carl Jefferson, who is in most ways responsible for the Concord Jazz Festival.
